t: WAI CLI does not exist — remove all references

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: A signal capturing the correction that there is no WAI CLI tool. Any mention of a 'WAI CLI', './WAI', 'WAI sync', 'WAI hub create', or similar shell commands referencing a WAI executable should be removed or replaced.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: This is not about the /wai skills or /wai-closeout slash commands — those are AI session skills and are correct. This only applies to references implying a shell-executable CLI tool called WAI.
_behavior_directive.corrective_action: When authoring or reviewing any framework file (template, skill, guide, state JSON), replace WAI CLI references with: AI session skills (/wai-teach, /wai-learn), manual setup instructions, or 'ask the user'.
affected_patterns: Check if WAI command is in PATH
